svg.text: C4 Code: STS tokens and presentations in portitor-identity
Two HTTP edges of the identity component, what they sign with portitor-dcp, and the ports (traits, dashed yellow) and adapters they use
The participant's P-256 key; it never
An at+jwt for our Credential Service: for
one verifier, with the scopes it may read
A scope by type or by id: parse, and
One presentation per profile, for the
POST /sts/token: the own connector gets a self-issued
ID token for an audience, with an access token if it
POST <credential service>/presentations/query: the verifier's token, its access token, then the credentials the
asked scopes and the access token both allow, not expired
The STS client secret, compared in constant time
did:web with a cache, over HTTPS
SQLite adapter, one file per process
C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. Dashed arrows: implements. The key signs every token, access token and presentation here; the connector only asks the STS.
